newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Feb 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Feb 18.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Sir Harry K. Tirvengadum of Mauritius takes over as managing director of multi-national carrier Air Afrique

- Ivory Coast and India conclude trade agreement under which India will supply medicines, vehicles and agricultural processing machines; agreement envisages possible installation of Indian commercial bank in Ivory Coast

- Heads of state of the Conseil de l'Entente, which groups Ivory Coast, Togo, Niger, Burkina Faso and Benin, to meet in Ivory Coast political capital Yamoussoukro Thursday to discuss development progress.
- U.S. forces in Ivory Coast to help airlift extra West African peacekeepers to Liberia ahead of May elections
- Opposition activist detained following unrest surrounding Ivory Coast's 1995 presidential election dies in custody in opposition stronghold of Gagnoa

- Angy dockers in Ivory Coast's second port of San Pedro stage token strike, accusing union officials of demanding payment for allocating work; regional administrator orders meeting to resolve the problem
- Ivory Coast to organise third MASA international arts festival in Abidjan from March 2 to 8; 22 countries to be represented.
- Students resume classes at Abidjan's universities of Cocody and Abobo-Adjame after five-day strike to demand release of militants and over grants and conditions.
- Tuberculosis on increase around Ivory Coast's second town of Bouake; doctors link this to spread of killer disease AIDS
- African Development Bank aims to boost capital for fifth time in January 1999
- Cosmetics industry in Ivory Coast enjoys turnover of 50 billion CFA francs
